# Workspace sources API

Manage repositories mounted into a workspace. Use identifiers returned by the API for repository references.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace_source` | [List workspace sources](#op-get-v1-workspace-source) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace_source` | [Create workspace source](#op-post-v1-workspace-source) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace_source/{id}` | [Get workspace source](#op-get-v1-workspace-source-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/workspace_source/{id}` | [Update workspace source](#op-put-v1-workspace-source-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/workspace_source/{id}` | [Delete workspace source](#op-delete-v1-workspace-source-id) |

## List workspace sources {#op-get-v1-workspace-source}

`GET /v1/workspace_source`

Returns a paginated list of WorkspaceSource

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/workspace_source" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of WorkspaceSource

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].alias` | string |  |
| `data[].branch` | string |  |
| `data[].commit` | string |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].external_auth_ref` | string | Credential reference only; secret values are never persisted here |
| `data[].external_connection_id` | string |  |
| `data[].external_provider` | string |  Allowed: none, github, gitlab, bitbucket, ssh, git. |
| `data[].external_repository_url` | string |  |
| `data[].internal_repository_id` | string | Authoritative repository in Adios Git |
| `data[].internal_repository_url` | string | Credential-free clone URL for the authoritative Adios Git repository |
| `data[].last_synced_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].metadata` | object |  |
| `data[].mount` | string |  |
| `data[].repository_path` | string |  |
| `data[].role` | string |  Allowed: primary, include. |
| `data[].source_key` | string | Credential-free logical identity used to reuse one internal repository across workspaces |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: active, archived. |
| `data[].sync_direction` | string |  Allowed: none, pull, push, bidirectional. |
| `data[].sync_error` | object |  |
| `data[].sync_status` | string |  Allowed: internal_only, pending, synced, ahead, behind, diverged, error. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workspace_id` | string |  |
| `data[].workspace_source_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

    {

## Create workspace source {#op-post-v1-workspace-source}

`POST /v1/workspace_source`

Creates a new WorkspaceSource

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alias` | string | yes |  |
| `branch` | string | yes |  Default: `"main"`. |
| `commit` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `external_auth_ref` | string | no | Credential reference only; secret values are never persisted here Default: `""`. |
| `external_connection_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `external_provider` | string | yes |  Allowed: none, github, gitlab, bitbucket, ssh, git. Default: `"none"`. |
| `external_repository_url` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `internal_repository_id` | string | yes | Authoritative repository in Adios Git |
| `internal_repository_url` | string | yes | Credential-free clone URL for the authoritative Adios Git repository |
| `last_synced_at` | integer | no | (Unix timestamp) Default: `0`. |
| `metadata` | object | no |  |
| `mount` | string | yes |  Default: `"."`. |
| `repository_path` | string | yes |  Default: `"."`. |
| `role` | string | yes |  Allowed: primary, include. Default: `"include"`. |
| `source_key` | string | yes | Credential-free logical identity used to reuse one internal repository across workspaces Default: `""`. |
| `status` | string | yes |  Allowed: active, archived. Default: `"active"`. |
| `sync_direction` | string | yes |  Allowed: none, pull, push, bidirectional. Default: `"none"`. |
| `sync_error` | object | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `sync_status` | string | yes |  Allowed: internal_only, pending, synced, ahead, behind, diverged, error. Default: `"internal_only"`. |
| `team_id` | string | yes |  |
| `workspace_id` | string | yes |  |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "alias": "example",
  "branch": "main",
  "commit": "",
  "external_auth_ref": "",
  "external_connection_id": "",
  "external_provider": "none",
  "external_repository_url": "",
  "internal_repository_id": "YOUR_INTERNAL_REPOSITORY_ID",
  "internal_repository_url": "YOUR_INTERNAL_REPOSITORY_URL",
  "last_synced_at": 0,
  "mount": ".",
  "repository_path": ".",
  "role": "include",
  "source_key": "",
  "status": "active",
  "sync_direction": "none",
  "sync_error": "",
  "sync_status": "internal_only",
  "team_id": "YOUR_TEAM_ID",
  "workspace_id": "YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID"
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.
